page_title: EVE 0-1 ARS | Everton v Arsenal 17/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is about to take a corner kick.
90+2' A player from Everton takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Here comes a substitution. Dwight McNeil is given a rest as he is replaced by Chermiti (Everton).
87' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Ashley Young is replaced by Nathan Patterson (Everton).
87' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
86' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
85' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) and Gabriel Jesus combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
80' Sean Dyche has decided to make a change. James Garner (Everton) replaces Abdoulaye Doucoure.
80' Substitution. Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Oleksandr Zinchenko walks off.
80' The substitution has been made. Kai Havertz (Arsenal) has replaced Fabio Vieira.
80' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
79' Simon Hooper interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ashley Young (Everton).
78' A lofted cross from Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
78' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) takes it short.
78' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Jordan Pickford pulls off a great save to deny Martin Odegaard (Arsenal), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
76' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
74' The ball finds it way to Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) inside the box and his first-time shot flies a whisker past the left post.
74' Corner kicks – 0:8.
73' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

73' A lofted pass picks out Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Everton.
69' 0 - 1 Bukayo Saka passes the ball into the penalty area. Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) collects it and quickly sends it into the left side of the goal via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
69' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
69' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Corner kick. Arsenal will have an opportunity.
68' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
68' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
67' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
66' Sean Dyche decides to make a substitution. Beto will be replaced by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton).
66' Here's the change. Eddie Nketiah leaves the pitch and Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) comes on as a substitute.
64' Ashley Young (Everton) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
64' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Fabio Vieira (Arsenal). Simon Hooper saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
62' A player from Everton commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
61' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
61' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) takes a short corner kick.
60' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
59' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take a corner kick.

59' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Arsenal earn a corner.
59' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
58' He should have scored! Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
58' Arsenal try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
56' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
56' Total attempts – 4:6.
56' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
54' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
52' A cross into the box from Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is cleared.
50' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
49' Simon Hooper blows his whistle as Idrissa Gueye (Everton) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
48' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Everton.
48' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Gabriel (Arsenal) for his blatant foul.
47' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
47' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went to the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford made an easy save.
47' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
46' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ashley Young (Everton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
45+2' Dwight McNeil (Everton) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
45+1' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) probably handled the ball. It's a free kick to Everton, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Flag up against Dwight McNeil (Everton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
43' Ben White (Arsenal) releases Bukayo Saka, who latched on to his perfect through pass and can continue with his team's attack.

41' Ben White (Arsenal) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jordan Pickford has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
39' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes a direct free kick.
39' Declan Rice (Arsenal) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) tackles a bit over-zealously and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
36' Simon Hooper blows for a foul after Beto (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
35' Arsenal are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) will take the free kick.
32' A player from Everton brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
32' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
29' A long pass, executed by Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
27' Declan Rice (Arsenal) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
26' Ben White (Arsenal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
26' Great teamplay by Arsenal as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
25' Mikel Arteta is forced to make a change. Gabriel Martinelli is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Leandro Trossard (Arsenal).
23' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' The goal by Arsenal won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
21' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Arsenal players aren’t happy.
20' Goal - 0:1! Fabio Vieira tees up Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Jordan Pickford.
19' Ben White (Arsenal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
18' Ben White (Arsenal) smashes the ball upfield and Gabriel Martinelli brings it down with a fine first touch.
18' Ben White (Arsenal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
17' The ball is cleared after Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
16' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) is caught offside!
16' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
16' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
13' Simon Hooper has a clear sight and sees a foul from Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal).
12' Simon Hooper interrupts the game. One of the players from Everton won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
10' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) controls a great pass from Oleksandr Zinchenko on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
9' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) works the corner short.
9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

9' Bukayo Saka almost found himself in a promising position after Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Everton.
5' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' This should have been a goal! Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) sends a killer pass into the box, but Martin Odegaard can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.
3' The resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) comes to nothing.

3' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
3' Oleksandr Zinchenko (Arsenal) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Gabriel Martinelli with a fine lofted pass.
2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) and Martin Odegaard combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
1' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Arsenal will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Simon Hooper.
